**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record VendorOptionChoice
```

One of the values a [VendorOption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/) can be set to.

## Constructors

```csharp
public VendorOptionChoice()
```

## Properties

### DisplayName

```csharp
public required string DisplayName { get; init; }
```

Gets a name to show people, such as "High" or "Staple top left". Comes from the printer driver where it has one.

### Value

```csharp
public required string Value { get; init; }
```

Gets the value to set in [PrintOptions.VendorOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#vendoroptions), such as `5` for IPP `print-quality`, or `psk:StapleTopLeft` for a Windows feature.
